canonical_source.title: ASJP Database - Wordlist Mundari
canonical_source.declared_source: Peiros 1998, Comparative Linguistics in Southeast Asia, Pacific Linguistics C-142, Australian National University
canonical_source.provider_license: CC BY 4.0 for the ASJP Database

identity_and_deduplication.canonicalization_rule: ASJP language page and serialized/export manifestations are one database source identity; Peiros 1998 is an upstream source, not an independent manifestation of ASJP.
identity_and_deduplication.independence_rule: ASJP-derived lexical forms must not count as independent corroboration of Peiros 1998 unless row-level provenance demonstrates another upstream source.

rights_access_consent.note: Database licensing does not establish rights or consent for upstream lexical elicitation/source material.

promotion.reason: The provider page verifies source identity, language identifiers and database license, but this pass did not obtain and hash a deterministic Mundari row export or establish row-level upstream provenance. Search-rendered lexical metadata is not promoted as exact-locator evidence.
promotion.required_locator_form: ASJP release/version + immutable export hash + Mundari row/item identifier + upstream-source field + license/provenance classification

verified_metadata.speaker_count_status: provider metadata only; not promoted as demographic evidence
verified_metadata.classification_note: provider presents WALS/Glottolog/Ethnologue classifications; these are derivative metadata, not independent evidence
